Add scope schema URL v1.44.0 to AWS Lambda invocation and API Gateway telemetry so backends can identify the emitted semantic conventions.

API Gateway spans also emit `url.path`, `url.scheme`, `http.route`, and sanitized `url.query` when available. Invocation exception logs carry the schema URL; SQS schema selection is unchanged.

The `cloud.resource_id` alias-to-version ARN change is split into #20493 for separate review. This PR preserves the invoked ARN as the resource ID.

AWS Lambda only; GenAI and generic JMX remain outside this PR.

<!-- START COPILOT CODING AGENT SUFFIX -->

- Related to #11939
metadata.title: Emit AWS Lambda schema URLs and API Gateway HTTP attributes
